mechanism_narrative: A higher-than-trend FEDFUNDS rate coincides with elevated consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL), depressing real interest rates and driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > FEDFUNDS_TREND + 0.25% AND CPIAUCSL > CPIAUCSL_TREND + 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) when proxies meet trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment growth (PAYEMS) above trend is associated with stronger consumer demand and supports positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show negative mean when PAYEMS crosses above trend.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals resilient manufacturing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are persistently negative despite multiple INDPRO upsurges above trend.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in resource availability (RSAFS) below trend indicates supply-side constraints, which tends to produce negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative in all RSAFS decline periods.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4.5% triggers a shift toward accommodative policy, resulting in positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during UNRATE < 4.5% regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in housing starts (HOUST) reflects cooling demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below trend.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE suggest dual policy and labor market easing, amplifying positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are flat or negative despite both proxies declining below trend.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 200) combined with weak industrial production (INDPRO < INDPRO_TREND) signals supply-demand imbalance, predicting negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 200 AND INDPRO < INDPRO_TREND for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when both triggers are met.
